question: Select the most appropriate options to fill in the blanks. The output voltage of L.V.D.T. transducer is practically ______ for displacements up to ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __linear; 5 mm**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• L.V.D.T.__ stands for Linear Variable Differential Transformer.
 
• The output voltage of an L.V.D.T. is linearly proportional to the displacement of its core within a specific range.
 
• For displacements up to 5 mm, the output of the L.V.D.T. remains linear.
 
• L.V.D.T. is widely used in applications requiring precise measurement of displacement or position.
 
• Beyond the linear range, the output may become non-linear, affecting the accuracy of measurements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Construction and Working:**
 
 
• An L.V.D.T. consists of a primary winding, two secondary windings, and a movable core.
 
• When an AC voltage is applied to the primary winding, the induced voltage in the secondary windings changes based on the core’s position.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• Used in aerospace, robotics, and industrial automation for displacement measurement.
 
• Commonly employed in strain gauges, pressure sensors, and accelerometers.
 
 
 
• **Advantages:**
 
 
• High accuracy and repeatability.
 
• Frictionless operation ensures a long operational life.
